title.zh: Python 3.13 现已成为默认版本

message.en:
Infernux Hub can manage multiple Python runtimes side by side. Infernux 0.4.0 targets Python 3.13; older projects and engine releases keep using the Python version recorded by their wheel.

A fresh Hub installation includes Python 3.13. After an in-app Hub upgrade, install it from Installs before installing Infernux 0.4.0. Existing projects keep their bound Python version.
message.zh:
Infernux Hub 可以并列管理多个 Python 运行环境。Infernux 0.4.0 对应 Python 3.13；旧项目和旧引擎版本继续使用各自 wheel 所记录的 Python 版本。

全新安装的 Hub 已包含 Python 3.13；如果通过 Hub 内更新升级，请先在“安装”页面安装它，再安装 Infernux 0.4.0。已有项目会保留其绑定的 Python 版本。
